description: Star Drift is a 90-second canvas arcade dodger: steer a small ship through falling debris, hold Space to brake, gather star sparks and chain quick pickups into a combo multiplier.
devlog: The third arcade ship reuses the Harvest flight engine with a heavier helm: the same canvas, HUD and synthesized bleeps, but thrust now answers a stronger damper while Space brakes hard, so threading debris feels like drifting rather than darting. Rocks fall just as fast and the combo window stays at 2.5 seconds, which keeps the whole family on one skill curve. Palette still resolves from computed site tokens at boot, particles still vanish under reduced motion, and the best score lives in its own guarded browser key.
pitch: Thread falling debris in a little ship. Hold Space to brake, chain pickups to grow your combo.
title: Star Drift
